verdict.rationale: Activepieces offers self-hosting and 'bring your own AI keys' so customers can route AI calls through their own provider contracts and infrastructure, which indirectly lets them avoid sending data to a third-party model trainer, and EU-cloud/self-hosted governance options reinforce data control (activepieces-docs-24, activepieces-docs-25, activepieces-docs-44). However, there is no explicit Activepieces policy statement about whether Activepieces itself or its AI features use customer data for model training, nor any opt-out toggle documented. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training/data-use policy statement, a documented opt-out setting, and independent confirmation of this guarantee.
